link.title: Descriptive Statistics
link.description: The first thing a quant does to any dataset — summarize it honestly, before any model. Five modules, worked one lecture at a time: the foundations (what statistics is, population vs sample), the variables you measure, the summary measures (center, spread, and why sample variance divides by n−1), the shape and position of a distribution (histograms, percentiles, the 5-number summary), and how two variables move together (covariance and correlation). Every page has a runnable in-browser example and its markets application. (Study reference: the 'Getting Started With Statistics' section of a Complete Data Science bootcamp — all notes and code are my own.)
